Question
========
What is the main purpose of BI tools?

Answerlist
----------
* transform data
* visualize and analyze data
* teach business professionals the basics of data analysis
* automate project management and replace human supervision of projects


Solution
========
The main purpose of BI tools is to visualize and analyze data.
